# Open Group ArchiMate® Model Exchange File Format XSDs

These schema files (XSD version 3.1, revision 15 July 2019) are
published by The Open Group for the ArchiMate® Model Exchange File
Format (namespace `http://www.opengroup.org/xsd/archimate/3.0/`).

They are vendored here solely so that the test suite can validate the
component's exchange export offline (the canonical source,
`https://www.opengroup.org/xsd/archimate/`, is not reachable from the
CI sandbox). They were obtained from the Archi project repository
(`archimatetool/archi`, `org.opengroup.archimate.xmlexchange/xsd/`),
which redistributes them for the same purpose.

ArchiMate® is a registered trademark of The Open Group. The schemas
remain the property of The Open Group and are not covered by this
repository's MIT license.
